messages:
Aria (Support): Hey team — Skylane reports they completed onboarding but they don't see an API key in the console. Customer id: org_skylane_42. Can someone check provisioning?
Lina (CS): They hit the self-serve flow ~45m ago. Says UI said 'Provisioning complete' but no key visible. I gave them the staging project name: skylane-prod.
Aria (Support): Got the org and project. I see a provisioner webhook success in our audit for that org but console shows no credentials bound. Pasting the prov log snippet:
```
INFO 2024-06-09T14:12:16Z provisioner: created service-cred id=svc_9a8b
INFO 2024-06-09T14:12:16Z claim: published claim token=ck_XXXXX ttl=60s
INFO 2024-06-09T14:12:16Z provisioner: response=200 bind_status=UNBOUND
```
Aria (Support): Note bind_status=UNBOUND — looks like create succeeded but binding step didn't complete.
Mateo (Infra): Hmm — that UNBOUND state usually means the service that reconciles claims timed out pulling the token. Any errors in the claim-collector logs?
Aria (Support): I'm checking now. No hard error, just repeated polls then GC after 60s.
Priya (DevEx): This rings a bell — there was a short spike in queue latency earlier that could cause the collector to miss ephemeral tokens. Workaround: we can manually bind the cred to the project and surface the key in the console. Do we want to do that while infra investigates?
Lina (CS): Customer is blocked from testing, they'd prefer manual bind. Please confirm steps and ETA.
Mateo (Infra): I'll run a manual reconcile for org_skylane_42. Command I'll use: `./opsctl reconcile-claims --org org_skylane_42 --project skylane-prod --force`
Mateo (Infra): Running now — will paste results.
provisioner-bot: reconcile-claims started for org_skylane_42 by Mateo at 2024-06-09T14:18:05Z. job_id=j-6c3d
Mateo (Infra): Done. Output: `bound 1/1 claims; service-cred svc_9a8b now bound -> project skylane-prod`
Aria (Support): Confirmed in console: key visible for skylane-prod. Sent customer a note with temporary key link. :thumbsup:
Priya (DevEx): Root cause likely ephemeral claim TTL + transient queue delay. I'll follow up with a small retry/backoff change to collector (PR coming).
ops-jordan: Please file an incident/bug and link repro steps and logs. Assign to infra for postmortem.
Aria (Support): Created internal ticket INF-2024-2786 with logs and reconciliation proof. Assigned to Mateo. I've updated the customer and asked them to try a minimal call to validate.
Lina (CS): Customer confirmed they can call the API and got 200s. Thanks team.
Mateo (Infra): I'll add a health-check to detect high collector latency and auto-trigger reconcile for in-flight claims. Will post timeline in INF-2024-2786.
Aria (Support): Closing thread once PR and ticket have owner updates. Follow-ups: Priya to open PR, Mateo to update ticket, ops-jordan to confirm monitoring alert.
